content:
---
- name: Provision only recurring backup credentials
  hosts: inventory_automation
  gather_facts: false
  become: true
  module_defaults:
    ansible.builtin.command:
      chdir: /
  vars:
    op: '{{ credential_operation }}'
    cli: [/usr/bin/doppler, --api-host, 'https://api.doppler.com', --no-check-version, --no-read-env, --attempts, '1', --timeout, 10s, --project, homelab-dev]
    provider_names: '{{ op.provider.references.keys() | list | sort }}'
    expected_names: '{{ (provider_names + op.provider.metadata_names) | sort }}'
  tasks:
    - name: Require the approved one-host bundle
      ansible.builtin.assert:
        that:
          - credential_bundle_verified | default(false) | bool
          - op.operation.execution_enabled | bool
          - op.operation.authorization_ready | bool
          - ansible_play_hosts_all == ['j2-svpi4mf']
          - ansible_host == '10.1.2.170'
          - not ansible_check_mode
    - name: Create temporary non-secret verification directory
      ansible.builtin.tempfile:
        state: directory
        prefix: nautobot-credential-check.
      register: check_root
    - name: Verify and provision within one bounded stage
      block:
        - name: Allow the service account to read root-owned verification code
          ansible.builtin.file:
            path: '{{ check_root.path }}'
            owner: root
            group: '985'
            mode: '0750'
        - name: Transfer only verification inputs
          ansible.builtin.copy:
            src: '{{ credential_bundle }}/{{ item }}'
            dest: '{{ check_root.path }}/{{ item }}'
            owner: root
            group: '985'
            mode: '0640'
          loop: [recurring_credentials.py, prerequisite_node.py, recurring_delivery.py, recurring_protection.py, operation.json, accepted.json]
        - name: Read independent pre-mutation host state
          ansible.builtin.command:
            argv: [/usr/bin/python3, -B, '{{ check_root.path }}/recurring_credentials.py', snapshot, '{{ check_root.path }}']
          changed_when: false
          register: before
        - name: Inspect credential namespace without reading values
          ansible.builtin.stat:
            path: '{{ op.delivery.directory }}'
            follow: false
            get_checksum: false
          register: existing
        - name: Refuse existing or partial credentials
          ansible.builtin.assert:
            that: not existing.stat.exists
        - name: Keep all provider responses and token material private
          no_log: true
          diff: false
          block:
            - name: List provider configs without reading secrets
              ansible.builtin.command:
                argv: '{{ cli + ["configs", "--json"] }}'
              delegate_to: localhost
              become: false
              changed_when: false
              register: configs
            - name: Require absent destination and a complete first page
              vars:
                rows: '{{ (configs.stdout | from_json).configs | default(configs.stdout | from_json) }}'
              ansible.builtin.assert:
                that:
                  - rows is sequence and rows is not string and rows is not mapping
                  - rows | length < 100
                  - op.provider.config not in (rows | map(attribute='name') | list)
                  - op.provider.parent in (rows | selectattr('environment', 'equalto', op.provider.environment) | map(attribute='name') | list)
            - name: Read only parent and canonical source names
              ansible.builtin.command:
                argv: '{{ cli + ["secrets", "--only-names", "--json", "--config", item] }}'
              loop: [prd, prd_restic, prd_b2]
              delegate_to: localhost
              become: false
              changed_when: false
              register: source_names
            - name: Refuse inherited secrets or missing canonical inputs
              ansible.builtin.assert:
                that:
                  - (source_names.results[0].stdout | from_json).keys() | list | sort == op.provider.metadata_names | sort
                  - "'NAUTOBOT_RESTIC_REPOSITORY_PASSWORD' in (source_names.results[1].stdout | from_json)"
                  - "'NAUTOBOT_RESTIC_B2_APPLICATION_KEY_ID' in (source_names.results[2].stdout | from_json)"
                  - "'NAUTOBOT_RESTIC_B2_APPLICATION_KEY' in (source_names.results[2].stdout | from_json)"
            - name: Create only the dedicated config
              ansible.builtin.command:
                argv: '{{ cli + ["configs", "create", op.provider.config, "--environment", op.provider.environment, "--json"] }}'
              delegate_to: localhost
              become: false
              register: config_created
              changed_when: true
            - name: Set reference expressions without copying canonical values
              ansible.builtin.command:
                argv: '{{ cli + ["secrets", "set", item.key + "=" + item.value, "--config", op.provider.config, "--silent"] }}'
              loop: '{{ op.provider.references | dict2items }}'
              delegate_to: localhost
              become: false
              changed_when: true
            - name: Read back raw reference expressions
              ansible.builtin.command:
                argv: '{{ cli + ["secrets", "get", item.key, "--raw", "--plain", "--config", op.provider.config] }}'
              loop: '{{ op.provider.references | dict2items }}'
              delegate_to: localhost
              become: false
              changed_when: false
              register: references
            - name: Require exact reference expressions
              ansible.builtin.assert:
                that: item.stdout == item.item.value
              loop: '{{ references.results }}'
            - name: Read complete destination name set
              ansible.builtin.command:
                argv: '{{ cli + ["secrets", "--only-names", "--json", "--config", op.provider.config] }}'
              delegate_to: localhost
              become: false
              changed_when: false
              register: destination_names
            - name: Require only the three references and provider metadata
              ansible.builtin.assert:
                that: (destination_names.stdout | from_json).keys() | list | sort == expected_names
            - name: Create one expiring read-only token
              ansible.builtin.command:
                argv: '{{ cli + ["configs", "tokens", "create", op.provider.token_name, "--access", "read", "--max-age", "2160h", "--plain", "--config", op.provider.config] }}'
              delegate_to: localhost
              become: false
              changed_when: true
              register: issued_token
            - name: Read token scope and expiry independently
              ansible.builtin.command:
                argv: '{{ cli + ["configs", "tokens", "--json", "--config", op.provider.config] }}'
              delegate_to: localhost
              become: false
              changed_when: false
              register: token_readback
            - name: Validate scope and expiry and discard token values from metadata
              ansible.builtin.command:
                argv: [/usr/bin/python3, -B, '{{ credential_bundle }}/recurring_credentials.py', metadata, '{{ credential_bundle }}']
                stdin: '{{ token_readback.stdout }}'
              delegate_to: localhost
              become: false
              changed_when: false
              register: metadata
            - name: Require bounded service-token shape
              ansible.builtin.assert:
                that:
                  - issued_token.stdout is match('^dp\.st\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$')
                  - issued_token.stdout | length <= 4096
            - name: Deliver and privately compare protected host files
              ansible.builtin.include_tasks: '{{ credential_bundle }}/delivery.yaml'
            - name: Resolve the three references as the native service account
              ansible.builtin.command:
                argv: [/usr/sbin/runuser, --user, nautobot, --, /usr/bin/python3, -B, '{{ check_root.path }}/recurring_credentials.py', probe, '{{ check_root.path }}']
              changed_when: false
              register: resolution
        - name: Read independent post-mutation host state
          ansible.builtin.command:
            argv: [/usr/bin/python3, -B, '{{ check_root.path }}/recurring_credentials.py', snapshot, '{{ check_root.path }}']
          changed_when: false
          register: after
        - name: Require preserved application and host context
          ansible.builtin.assert:
            that: (before.stdout | from_json) == (after.stdout | from_json)
        - name: Save only non-secret acceptance observations
          ansible.builtin.copy:
            content: '{{ {"stage_checks_passed": true, "accepted": false, "metadata": metadata.stdout | from_json, "resolution": resolution.stdout | from_json, "before": before.stdout | from_json, "after": after.stdout | from_json} | to_nice_json }}'
            dest: '{{ credential_evidence }}/observations.json'
            mode: '0600'
          delegate_to: localhost
          become: false
      rescue:
        - name: Revoke only the newly identified token
          ansible.builtin.command:
            argv: '{{ cli + ["configs", "tokens", "revoke", "--slug", (metadata.stdout | from_json).token_slug, "--config", op.provider.config] }}'
          when: metadata is defined and metadata.rc | default(1) == 0
          delegate_to: localhost
          become: false
          no_log: true
          register: revoked
          failed_when: false
          changed_when: revoked.rc == 0
        - name: Remove only files in the directory created by this attempt
          ansible.builtin.command:
            argv: [/usr/bin/python3, -B, '{{ check_root.path }}/recurring_credentials.py', cleanup, '{{ check_root.path }}']
          when: directory_created is defined and directory_created.rc | default(1) == 0
          register: removed
          failed_when: false
          changed_when: removed.rc == 0
        - name: Record failure and retained provider residue without secret output
          ansible.builtin.copy:
            content: '{{ {"accepted": false, "manual_intervention": config_created is defined, "provider_config_retained": config_created is defined, "token_revoked": revoked.rc | default(1) == 0, "host_credentials_removed": removed.rc | default(1) == 0} | to_nice_json }}'
            dest: '{{ credential_evidence }}/failure.json'
            mode: '0600'
          delegate_to: localhost
          become: false
        - name: Stop without retrying provider mutation
          ansible.builtin.fail:
            msg: Credential provisioning failed; review sanitized failure receipt and retained provider state.
      always:
        - name: Remove this attempt's non-secret verification directory
          ansible.builtin.file:
            path: '{{ check_root.path }}'
            state: absent
